## Design

### 2026-09-30 — Researched existing smart and minimalist desk clocks to understand how they use screen space, physical controls and enclosure design. I compared several designs and decided that NOVA should have a com

**2.5h**

Researched existing smart and minimalist desk clocks to understand how they use screen space, physical controls and enclosure design. I compared several designs and decided that NOVA should have a compact rectangular form with a large central display and a simple physical control on the side. I also defined the first feature set and created initial concept designs.
